notes: SPICe: early-phase consumption of around 400 GWh/yr (~4.5% of Scottish domestic consumption per press).

Ultimate energy use 'possibly rising to 4,000 GWh/yr (4 TWh)' — SPICe notes this would equal ~7.7% of all electricity generated in Scotland in 2024. Developer says the facility would run on renewable electricity and make use of curtailed generation (matching method unstated).

methodology: 600 MW x 80% load factor x 8,760 h = ~4,200 GWh/yr; load factor taken from NESO FES 2025 pathway assumptions (fleet average 70%, hyperscale/AI 80-85%).
notes: APRS equates this to ~53% of Scottish households' electricity use or ~20% of Scotland's total 2024 electricity consumption (21.7 TWh). Broadly consistent with the application's 4,000 GWh figure.
